```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open("content/contact.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

page = data.get("page", {})
contacts = data.get("contacts", [])
feedback = data.get("feedback", {})

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

contact_cards = ""

for person in contacts:
    name = safe(person.get("name"))
    role = safe(person.get("role"))
    address1 = safe(person.get("address_line1"))
    address2 = safe(person.get("address_line2"))
    email = safe(person.get("email"))
    phone = safe(person.get("phone"))
    phone_link = "".join(
        c for c in str(person.get("phone", ""))
        if c.isdigit() or c == "+"
    )

    contact_cards += f"""
    <article class="cw-person-card">
      <div class="cw-person-icon" aria-hidden="true">✉</div>
      <h3>{name}</h3>
      <p class="cw-person-role">{role}</p>
      <div class="cw-person-details">
        <p>{address1}<br>{address2}</p>
        <p><a href="mailto:{email}">{email}</a></p>
        <p><a href="tel:{phone_link}">{phone}</a></p>
      </div>
    </article>
    """

categories = "".join(
    f'<option value="{safe(category)}">{safe(category)}</option>'
    for category in feedback.get("categories", [])
)

form_id = safe(feedback.get("formspree_id", "YOUR_FORM_ID"))

html = f"""
<div class="cw-contact-page">

  <header class="cw-contact-hero">
    <div class="cw-contact-hero-inner">
      <p class="cw-contact-eyebrow">NOAA CoastWatch West Coast</p>
      <h1>{safe(page.get("heading"))}</h1>
      <p>{safe(page.get("description"))}</p>
    </div>
  </header>

  <section class="cw-contact-section">
    <div class="cw-contact-section-heading">
      <h2>Contact Our Team</h2>
      <p>Reach out directly to our CoastWatch staff.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="cw-contact-grid">
      {contact_cards}
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="cw-feedback-section">
    <div class="cw-contact-section-heading">
      <h2>{safe(feedback.get("heading"))}</h2>
      <p>{safe(feedback.get("description"))}</p>
    </div>

    <div class="cw-feedback-card">

      <form
        id="cw-feedback-form"
        action="https://formspree.io/f/{form_id}"
        method="POST"
      >

        <input type="hidden"
               name="_subject"
               value="CoastWatch Website Feedback">

        <div class="cw-form-grid">

          <div class="cw-form-field">
            <label for="cw-name">
              Full Name <span>*</span>
            </label>
            <input id="cw-name" type="text"
                   name="name" autocomplete="name" required>
          </div>

          <div class="cw-form-field">
            <label for="cw-email">
              Email Address <span>*</span>
            </label>
            <input id="cw-email" type="email"
                   name="email" autocomplete="email" required>
          </div>

          <div class="cw-form-field">
            <label for="cw-organization">
              Organization <span>*</span>
            </label>
            <input id="cw-organization" type="text"
                   name="organization" required>
          </div>

          <div class="cw-form-field">
            <label for="cw-phone">Phone Number</label>
            <input id="cw-phone" type="tel"
                   name="phone" autocomplete="tel">
          </div>

          <div class="cw-form-field">
            <label for="cw-address">Address</label>
            <input id="cw-address" type="text"
                   name="address" autocomplete="street-address">
          </div>

          <div class="cw-form-field">
            <label for="cw-location">
              City, State, ZIP, Country
            </label>
            <input id="cw-location" type="text"
                   name="location">
          </div>

          <div class="cw-form-field cw-form-full">
            <label for="cw-category">
              Organization Category <span>*</span>
            </label>
            <select id="cw-category" name="category" required>
              <option value="" disabled selected>
                Select a category
              </option>
              {categories}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div class="cw-form-field cw-form-full">
            <label for="cw-comment">
              Comments or Feedback <span>*</span>
            </label>
            <textarea
              id="cw-comment"
              name="comment"
              rows="6"
              placeholder="Please enter your comments here..."
              required
            ></textarea>
          </div>

        </div>

        <p class="cw-form-required">* Required fields</p>

        <div class="cw-form-actions">
          <button type="submit" class="cw-submit-btn">
            Submit Feedback
          </button>

          <button type="reset" class="cw-reset-btn">
            Clear Form
          </button>
        </div>

      </form>

    </div>
  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
